opening.argument: The presentation makes paid participation the gateway to projected earnings: viewers are offered packages with token quantities and are told, “Do you want to mine the coins now? You can mine your coins.” It then links obtaining coins to a return—“First You sell your coin and earn money”—while describing direct sales, matching bonuses, and generation-based compensation. The network structure is explicit: “Like this 3rd Generation gives 20% and 4th Generation is 25%.” Although a prediction disclaimer qualifies the projections, the presentation still frames package purchases, token accumulation, later sale or trading, and future earning benefits as the opportunity. Completed transactions, realized returns, token liquidity, and delivery of rewards remain unverified.
